title: Superscript and subscript
---

Alan Li<sup>1</sup>, Oliver Maclaren<sup>1,2</sup>

<sup>1</sup> Department of Engineering Science

<sup>2</sup> Research group

## Inline notation

Water is H<sub>2</sub>O. An example power is x<sup>2</sup>.

Native Pandoc notation still works: Name^1,2^ and H~2~O.

Multiple markers with a space: Name<sup>1, 2</sup>.

Entity markers: Name<sup>&#8224; &Dagger;</sup>.

[an:Check the affiliation for Alan Li<sup>1</sup>.]

## Literal examples

Inline code: `Alan Li<sup>1</sup>`.

Escaped: Alan Li\<sup>1</sup>.

```html
Alan Li<sup>1</sup>
H<sub>2</sub>O
```

## Unsupported HTML stays literal

<sup class="custom">1</sup>

<sup><em>nested HTML</em></sup>
